source_files.role: 95 segment IDs, legacy types and schematic coordinates

transformations: map legacy IDs 1..95 bijectively to bvs95-001..bvs95-095
map legacy vessel types 0/1/2 to artery/vein/organ_bed
convert all schematic coordinates from centimetres to metres
replace the missing vessel-9 legacy default with the documented 0.2875 left and 0.7125 right internal-jugular cohort mean
normalize the stationary flow to 6.0 L/min at legacy vessel 2
derive equivalent circular area and diameter from flow and documented historical class velocity

known_limitations: The geometry is schematic and confined to two depth planes.
The absolute 6.0 L/min flow is a normalization assumption, not a measurement of the historical reference person.
Equivalent diameters are derived transport parameters, not anatomical measurements.
The vessel-9 split is a cohort mean for healthy young adults in rest and supine posture and has high inter-individual variability.
Fingerprint formation times remain a separately licensed source input and are not part of the vascular-graph contract.
